title: Transfer window planning
summary: Compare and review circular or elliptical orbit changes.

blocks.text: While coasting in a bound orbit, open Maneuver from Instruments and expand Transfer window. Destinations are grouped by the current body, its moons, the parent SOI, other planets and their moons. Body names identify which orbit they belong to, and unavailable transfer types are marked. Choose the current body and enter a target altitude in metres above its reference radius. Turn off Circular target to enter separate low/high altitudes. Starting and target orbits may be elliptical; both must clear the highest terrain. This increment handles orbit raising/lowering. Moon and planet transfers remain in development and explain that limit immediately when selected; Find options stays disabled for unavailable types.

Find options compares Efficient (lowest impulse cost among the sampled opportunities) and Faster (earlier arrival when available). Compare current wait, travel time, total delta-v and each burn duration. The search is bounded; these labels do not promise a global optimum. Changes to thrust, orbit, destination or altitude discard old results.

Use an option to create editable Departure and Arrival nodes. Generation never arms thrust. Select a node to edit it; Execute burn is a separate choice for each node, or fly manually. The dashed preview assumes instantaneous impulses. Long burns can change arrival substantially. After a finite or manually flown departure, mark manual nodes flown if needed and Review remaining against actual flight before attempting arrival. Export plan stores inert intent; Save universe includes it. Loaded plans always need review.
